# IAM Access Analyzer

**Parity grade: A** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/accessanalyzer@v1.51.4` · last audited 2026-10-07 (`49cff86c4`)

### Known gaps

- ListFindings/ListFindingsV2/ListAccessPreviewFindings and archive-rule filters: Contains has no documented semantics in the pinned SDK (Criterion.Contains is described only as a "contains" operator) and createdAt/updatedAt/analyzedAt filter value formats are undocumented, so both are treated as matching.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- FindingSummary error/resourceControlPolicyRestriction/sources, AnalyzerSummary managedBy/statusReason and AccessPreviewSummary statusReason are never emitted: they come from a real policy-analysis engine, service-linked provisioning or analysis failures, none of which exist (findings are only seeded). Filters on error/resourceControlPolicyRestriction therefore see no values.
- GetFindingRecommendation.recommendedSteps is always [] -- unused-permission recommendation generation needs a real access-activity analysis engine (gopherstack-kwht).
- GetGeneratedPolicy generatedPolicies is always [] -- policy synthesis from CloudTrail activity needs real activity data (gopherstack-kwht).
- types.AnalyzedResource Actions/Error/SharedVia/Status are never emitted: they are outputs of resource analysis, and analyzed resources are only seeded.
- ValidatePolicy checks are a coarse subset of IAM Access Analyzer's; locations never use the substring path element because no check analyzes inside a literal string value.

### Deferred

- store.go/store_setup.go/persistence.go internal locking and Table[T]/Index[T] generic implementation (pkgs/store) not re-audited line-by-line this pass beyond the DeleteAnalyzer cascade fix and the Configuration field addition to the Analyzer table's JSON shape (verified generically compatible with store.Table's JSON-marshal-based Snapshot/Restore, no special-casing needed); no correctness issues observed.
